description_snippet:
Business Analyst will be responsible for driving key technology initiatives across the Loan Origination System (LOS) and LSQ (CRM) platforms. The role requires strong product ownership, business analysis, cross-functional coordination, and hands-on management of project deliveryfrom requirement gathering to UAT and go live readiness.

Job Description : 

Product Ownership & Requirement Management : 

- Understand business needs and convert them into clear, structured Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) for the Tech team.

- Prioritize enhancements and projects based on business value, operational impact, compliance needs, and regulatory timelines.

- Maintain a transparent and updated product backlog with effort vs. impact assessment.

Project Execution Across LOS & LSQ (CRM) : 

- Lead end-to-end execution of all enhancements or new module development across LOS and LSQ.

- Coordinate with technology teams on solution design, effort estimation, timelines, and development progress.

- Ensure interdependencies between modules (credit, ops, sales, etc.) are mapped and managed proactively.

Stakeholder Management : 

- Engage with Credit, Operations, Risk, Sales, Compliance and other teams to validate requirements and incorporate their feedback.

- Conduct regular project updates, align decisions, and obtain sign-offs at key stages.

- Serve as the primary bridge between business users and technology.

Testing, UAT & Go-Live Readiness : 

- Create UAT test cases and manage end-to-end testing for all LOS/ LSQ releases.

- Validate that delivered features match business needs and close all gaps before deployment.

- Drive go-live planning, communication, training material creation, and rollout execution.

Adoption, Training & Monitoring : 

- Prepare process notes, SOPs, and training modules for end users.

- Conduct training sessions for business teams and ops/credit users.

- Track post-go-live adoption, usage metrics, user feedback, and ensure continuous improvement

Job Purpose:

This position is responsible for leading the product strategy, innovation, and end-to-end execution of Loan Origination Systems (LOS) and Loan Management Systems (LMS), ensuring strong alignment with business objectives and customer needs through effective leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and management of complex product lifecycles.

- Drive customer journey digitization from Loan onboarding to disbursement.
- Collaborate closely with engineering, production, marketing, and sales teams on the development, QA, and release of products and balance of resources to ensure success for the entire organization
- Create and maintain Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), process flows, wireframes, and user stories.
- Translate product strategy into detailed requirements for prototype construction and final product development by engineering teams
- Prioritize the feature roll outs, improvements and bug resolution timelines and effectively communicate to all stakeholders.
- Define and document credit underwriting workflows, loan origination journeys, approval hierarchies, and disbursement processes.
- Prepare JIRA user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, and functional requirements for development teams.
- Appraise new product ideas and strategize to differentiate in the market
- Analyze product requirements and develop appropriate programs to ensure theyre successfully achieved
- Provide detailed solution design artifacts to support the build and test delivery phases
- Recommend, conceive & implement enhanced tools/processes to streamline daily support requirements
